description: Akamai Technologies, Inc., founded in 1998, provides solutions that help global enterprises build, secure and accelerate their applications and digital experiences, with the mission of powering and protecting life online. As of December 31, 2025, its massively distributed global infrastructure comprised more than 4,300 edge points of presence in over 130 countries and approximately 700 cities, integrated with roughly 1,200 network partners, giving it visibility into traffic volumes, congestion, attack patterns and vulnerabilities. It leverages these insights to offer security solutions that protect customers from threats and attacks, along with full-stack compute solutions for building and delivering high-performance, low-latency applications.
